About / How this works

WHY · WHAT · HOW · SOURCES

Why built

  • Static, free, no-backend job explorer for 4 major metros (LA / SF Bay / SEA / NYC) + US-remote
  • Daily refreshed real listings from free public sources. No paywalls, no API keys in client
  • Single HTML file anyone can open and share. Data baked as window.JOBS_DATA, optional assets/jobs.json
  • Help job seekers explore without sign-in or tracking. Built direct, low-fluff, pragmatic engineering style

What it helps

  • Explore by role → market → level (drill-down with breadcrumbs + chips)
  • See remote / hybrid / onsite badges, salary when listed, source site per listing, full description in-app
  • Tappable charts re-aggregate as filters change. Source / company breakdowns with filter-by-click
  • 5th stat: avg listings per source (rounded). Snapshot line shows consolidation days
  • Light / dark, mobile-friendly, keyboard-accessible. In-app detail panel, no external visit needed

How roles chosen

Original Aug 27 2026: user said "just use 10 most wanted roles including software engineer". Proposed mix: Software Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Product Manager, Project Manager, Marketing Manager, Financial Analyst, Accountant, Registered Nurse, Customer Success Manager. User approved.

Revised Aug 29 2026 to BLS 2025-2035 projections (last modified Aug 27 2026):

  • Most New Jobs: Home health/personal care aides +847.3k, RNs +194.7k, General & ops managers +181.3k, Software developers +174.7k, Medical/health services managers +155.1k, Nurse practitioners +137.8k — BLS Most Growth
  • Fastest Growing %: Nurse practitioners 41.0%, Data scientists 34.6%, Medical/health services managers 24.2%, Info security analysts 21.0% — BLS Fastest Growing

Balanced volume + % growth + relevance to LA / SF / SEA / NYC / Remote tech hubs → new 10 BLS-aligned:

  1. Software Developer (BLS 15-1252, 174.7k new)
  2. Registered Nurse (29-1141, 194.7k)
  3. General and Operations Manager (11-1021, 181.3k)
  4. Data Scientist (15-2051, 95.4k, 34.6% growth)
  5. Medical and Health Services Manager (11-9111, 155.1k, 24.2%)
  6. Nurse Practitioner (29-1171, 137.8k, 41% fastest)
  7. Information Security Analyst (15-1212, 40.6k, 21%)
  8. Financial Manager (11-3031, 84.9k)
  9. Project Management Specialist (13-1082, 73.2k)
  10. Market Research Analyst (13-1161, 66.3k)

Tradeoff: drops Data Analyst, Product Manager, Accountant, CSM (lower growth this cycle) but preserves markets for future expansion. Keeps software must-have but uses BLS-correct label "Software Developer". Splits RN vs NP (previously conflated).

Sources: free public boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Amazon Jobs search.json, Remotive, Himalayas, GitHub SimplifyJobs). No API keys. DatadogHQ.com excluded per info-sharing permission request (2026-08-29). Daily cron 05:39 PT re-runs collection, daily snapshot, 7-day merge, description top-up.

Links use the listing URLs stored in this snapshot. Availability can change.
